cues.text: The summer festival at Naganaki Shrine: the grounds are crowded and lined with stalls. You and Yuko stand together, watching someone in a yukata go by.
You and Yuko make your way through the crowd to a takoyaki stall.
At the lucky-draw stall, you reach into the box and draw a ticket.
Yuko cheers at your prize. A little later, she flips open her phone and checks the time.
